summary: What's New modal triple-dismissal parity and container cleanliness verified: modal opens cleanly into #modalHolder upon footer trigger. Dismissal across all 3 independent vectors—(1) backdrop overlay click (.overlay[data-action='modal-bg']), (2) global Escape keydown, and (3) top-right close button (.whatsnew-modal button.close)—consistently unmounts the modal, empties #modalHolder (0 children, innerHTML empty), and leaves no dangling overlay DOM nodes or pointer traps.
